json.title: Endless Coast Summer
json.logline: A nostalgic journey along golden coastal cliffs where a sun-drenched memory of youth feels boundless and warm.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: First gentle key of felt piano notes over a static silhouette
Color spreads softly across the gouache texture
Sunlight glints on chrome and sea foam as tempo rises
Explosion of golden light and wide coastal vista as ocean breeze opens up
Layered memory reflections shimmering like sunlight on water
Warm glow fading into soft painterly dusk
Final piano chord decays into quiet amber haze

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle creep forward on the protagonist sitting by the open vintage car window.
scenes.action: The protagonist rests a chin on one hand, gazing toward the quiet horizon.
scenes.setting: Interior of a vintage convertible parked along a quiet coastal overlook at early golden hour.

scenes.camera_note: Lateral drift showing depth between foreground grass and background ocean.
scenes.action: Gouache brushstrokes blend across the sunlit coastal cliffs.
scenes.setting: Winding coastal highway lined with wild cypress trees and sun-bleached terracotta dirt banks.

scenes.camera_note: Tilting up from the spinning classic car wheel to the open sky.
scenes.action: Golden sea breeze whips the protagonist's hair in soft ribbons.
scenes.setting: Open coastal road running alongside glistening turquoise waves.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid warm push toward the protagonist's joyful expression.
scenes.action: Sunlight flares bright across the profile of the smiling protagonist.
scenes.setting: Passenger seat of the vintage car drenched in warm amber sunlight.

scenes.camera_note: Dramatic wide pull back revealing the endless coastal panorama and speeding car.
scenes.action: The vintage car glides along the high cliff bridge above ocean surf.
scenes.setting: Panoramic ocean cliff bridge at peak sunset with glowing pink clouds and shimmering water.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-layered painterly drift of overlapping summer memories.
scenes.action: Soft gouache layers drift together with sparkling sea spray highlights.
scenes.setting: Montage of ocean spray, distant lighthouse, and sunlit highway ribbons.

scenes.camera_note: Slow easing dolly out into quiet evening shadows.
scenes.action: The protagonist leans back against the seat headrest looking at dusk sky.
scenes.setting: Parked car overlooking the calm dusk ocean under deep violet-blue twilight.
